issues.title: [BUG] `mp_rank_00_000` could be optim and dense model doesn't have ep size in vllm_utils.py

linked_prs.title: fix(vllm_utils): skip optim ckpt in loading rank0 state_dict and support qwen dense model

ai_judgment.response:
**Yes**  
This is an agent issue as it involves errors in handling LLM operations, specifically related to model setup and checkpoint loading for the QWen dense model. The issue pertains to LLM provider integration and parameter handling, aligning with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category.
